_comment: ISC Mathematics syllabus structure. Source: CISCE ISC 2025-26 spec. Used as the topic picker source — the LLM generates questions on the chosen topic.

chapters.label: Sets
chapters.description: Set notation, types of sets, subsets, power sets, universal set, Venn diagrams, union, intersection, complement, difference, and cardinality formulas including the inclusion-exclusion principle.

chapters.label: Relations and Functions
chapters.description: Ordered pairs, Cartesian product, relations, domain and range, types of relations, functions as special relations, one-one, onto, and composition of functions.

chapters.label: Trigonometric Functions
chapters.description: Angles and their measures (degrees and radians), trigonometric ratios, identities, graphs of sin/cos/tan, trigonometric equations, and general solutions.

chapters.label: Principle of Mathematical Induction
chapters.description: Statement of the principle, proving formulas for sums, divisibility, and inequalities using the base case and inductive step.

chapters.label: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
chapters.description: Complex numbers as a+bi, algebra of complex numbers, modulus, conjugate, Argand plane, and solving quadratic equations with complex roots.

chapters.label: Linear Inequalities
chapters.description: Solving linear inequalities in one and two variables, graphical representation, and system of linear inequalities.

chapters.label: Permutations and Combinations
chapters.description: Fundamental counting principle, factorial notation, permutations (nPr), combinations (nCr), and applications to word problems.

chapters.label: Binomial Theorem
chapters.description: Binomial theorem for positive integral index, general term, middle term, and applications of binomial coefficients.

chapters.label: Sequences and Series
chapters.description: Arithmetic progressions (AP), geometric progressions (GP), sum of n terms, arithmetic and geometric means, and special series (sum of squares, cubes).

chapters.label: Straight Lines
chapters.description: Slope of a line, various forms of equations (slope-intercept, point-slope, two-point, intercept), angle between lines, distance from a point to a line, and family of lines.

chapters.label: Conic Sections
chapters.description: Circle, parabola, ellipse, and hyperbola — standard equations, focus, directrix, eccentricity, and latus rectum.

chapters.label: Introduction to Three-Dimensional Geometry
chapters.description: Coordinate axes in 3D, distance formula, section formula, and coordinates of a point dividing a line segment.

chapters.label: Limits and Derivatives
chapters.description: Intuitive idea of limits, limit laws, limits of polynomials and rational functions, definition of derivative, derivative of sum/difference/product/quotient, and derivatives of polynomial and trigonometric functions.

chapters.label: Mathematical Reasoning
chapters.description: Statements, logical connectives (and, or, not, implies, if and only if), quantifiers, validity of statements, and methods of proof.

chapters.label: Statistics
chapters.description: Measures of dispersion — range, mean deviation, variance, and standard deviation for grouped and ungrouped data.

chapters.label: Probability
chapters.description: Random experiments, sample spaces, events, classical and axiomatic probability, addition theorem, and complementary events.

chapters.label: Relations and Functions
chapters.description: Types of relations (reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence), types of functions (injective, surjective, bijective), composition and invertible functions, and binary operations.

chapters.label: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
chapters.description: Definition, domain, range, and principal value branches of inverse trigonometric functions, and properties of inverse trig functions.

chapters.label: Matrices
chapters.description: Types of matrices, matrix operations (addition, scalar multiplication, multiplication), transpose, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices, and elementary row/column operations.

chapters.label: Determinants
chapters.description: Determinant of a square matrix (up to 3x3), properties, cofactors, adjoint, inverse of a matrix, and solving systems of linear equations using Cramer's rule.

chapters.label: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.description: Continuity of functions, differentiability, chain rule, derivatives of implicit functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, logarithmic differentiation, and Rolle's and Mean Value theorems.

chapters.label: Applications of Derivatives
chapters.description: Rate of change, increasing/decreasing functions, tangents and normals, maxima and minima (first and second derivative tests), and applied optimization problems.

chapters.label: Integrals
chapters.description: Indefinite integrals (substitution, partial fractions, by parts), definite integrals, fundamental theorem of calculus, and properties of definite integrals.

chapters.label: Applications of Integrals
chapters.description: Area under curves, area between two curves using integration.

chapters.label: Differential Equations
chapters.description: Order and degree, formation of differential equations, methods of solution (variable separable, homogeneous, linear first-order), and applications.

chapters.label: Vector Algebra
chapters.description: Vectors and scalars, magnitude and direction, position vectors, addition, scalar multiplication, dot product, cross product, and scalar triple product.

chapters.label: Three-Dimensional Geometry
chapters.description: Direction cosines and ratios, equations of a line in space, angle between lines, shortest distance, equation of a plane, angle between planes, and distance of a point from a plane.

chapters.label: Linear Programming
chapters.description: Formulation of LP problems, graphical method of solution, feasible and infeasible regions, optimal solution, and bounded/unbounded regions.

chapters.label: Probability
chapters.description: Conditional probability, multiplication theorem, independent events, Bayes' theorem, and probability distributions (mean and variance of random variables, binomial distribution).

computer-science.label: Computer Science (Phase 2 — coming soon)
computer-science._note: Roadmapped, not shipped in v1. Java code execution sandbox and SQL question handling are separate engineering problems.

chapters.label: Units and Measurements
chapters.description: SI units, dimensions and dimensional analysis, significant figures, orders of magnitude, and errors in measurement.

chapters.label: Kinematics
chapters.description: Motion in a straight line and in a plane, velocity and acceleration, equations of motion, relative velocity, and projectile motion.

chapters.label: Laws of Motion
chapters.description: Newton's three laws, inertia, momentum, friction, and dynamics of circular motion including banking of roads.

chapters.label: Work, Energy and Power
chapters.description: Work done by a force, kinetic and potential energy, the work-energy theorem, power, and elastic/inelastic collisions.

chapters.label: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
chapters.description: Centre of mass, torque, angular momentum, moment of inertia, and rolling motion of rigid bodies.

chapters.label: Gravitation
chapters.description: Newton's law of gravitation, gravitational field and potential, orbital and escape velocity, and Kepler's laws.

chapters.label: Mechanical Properties of Solids
chapters.description: Stress, strain, Hooke's law, elastic moduli, and elastic potential energy in deformed solids.

chapters.label: Mechanical Properties of Fluids
chapters.description: Pressure, Pascal's and Archimedes' principles, viscosity, Bernoulli's theorem, and surface tension.

chapters.label: Thermal Properties of Matter
chapters.description: Temperature, thermal expansion, calorimetry, latent heat, and modes of heat transfer.

chapters.label: Thermodynamics
chapters.description: Thermodynamic system and processes, the first and second laws, heat engines, and the Carnot cycle.

chapters.label: Kinetic Theory of Gases
chapters.description: The molecular model of an ideal gas, pressure from molecular motion, kinetic interpretation of temperature, and degrees of freedom.

chapters.label: Oscillations
chapters.description: Simple harmonic motion, its energy, and oscillations of springs and pendulums including damping and resonance.

chapters.label: Waves
chapters.description: Transverse and longitudinal waves, the wave equation, superposition, standing waves, beats, and the Doppler effect.

chapters.label: Electric Charges and Fields
chapters.description: Electric charge, Coulomb's law, the electric field, field lines, dipoles, and Gauss's law with applications.

chapters.label: Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance
chapters.description: Electric potential and potential energy, equipotentials, capacitors, dielectrics, and energy stored.

chapters.label: Current Electricity
chapters.description: Electric current, Ohm's law, resistivity, combinations of resistors, EMF, and Kirchhoff's laws with the Wheatstone bridge.

chapters.label: Moving Charges and Magnetism
chapters.description: Magnetic force on charges and currents, the Biot-Savart and Ampere laws, solenoids, and moving-coil instruments.

chapters.label: Magnetism and Matter
chapters.description: Bar magnets, the magnetic dipole, Earth's magnetism, and dia-, para- and ferromagnetic materials.

chapters.label: Electromagnetic Induction
chapters.description: Magnetic flux, Faraday's and Lenz's laws, motional EMF, eddy currents, and self and mutual inductance.

chapters.label: Alternating Current
chapters.description: AC voltage and current, phasors, reactance and impedance, LCR circuits, resonance, and transformers.

chapters.label: Electromagnetic Waves
chapters.description: Displacement current, the nature of electromagnetic waves, and the electromagnetic spectrum.

chapters.label: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments
chapters.description: Reflection and refraction, mirrors and lenses, total internal reflection, prisms, and optical instruments.

chapters.label: Wave Optics
chapters.description: Huygens' principle, interference, diffraction, and polarisation of light.

chapters.label: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
chapters.description: The photoelectric effect, Einstein's photon theory, and the de Broglie wavelength of matter.

chapters.label: Atoms
chapters.description: Atomic models, the hydrogen spectrum, and Bohr's model of the atom.

chapters.label: Nuclei
chapters.description: Nuclear size and composition, mass-energy, binding energy, radioactivity, and fission and fusion.

chapters.label: Semiconductor Electronics
chapters.description: Semiconductors, p-n junctions and diodes, rectification, and basic logic gates.

chapters.label: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
chapters.description: The mole concept, stoichiometry, empirical and molecular formulae, and concentration terms.

chapters.label: Structure of Atom
chapters.description: Subatomic particles, atomic models, quantum numbers, and electronic configuration.

chapters.label: Classification of Elements and Periodicity
chapters.description: The modern periodic table and periodic trends in properties.

chapters.label: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
chapters.description: Ionic and covalent bonding, VSEPR shapes, hybridisation, and molecular orbital ideas.

chapters.label: States of Matter: Gases and Liquids
chapters.description: Gas laws, the ideal gas equation, kinetic theory, and properties of liquids.

chapters.label: Chemical Thermodynamics
chapters.description: Energy changes in reactions, enthalpy, entropy, and spontaneity.

chapters.label: Equilibrium
chapters.description: Physical and chemical equilibrium, Le Chatelier's principle, and ionic equilibrium.

chapters.label: Redox Reactions
chapters.description: Oxidation, reduction, oxidation numbers, and balancing redox equations.

chapters.label: Hydrogen
chapters.description: Position of hydrogen, its isotopes, preparation, and compounds including water and peroxide.

chapters.label: The s-Block Elements
chapters.description: Alkali and alkaline earth metals: trends, reactions, and important compounds.

chapters.label: The p-Block Elements (Groups 13 & 14)
chapters.description: The boron and carbon families: trends and important compounds.

chapters.label: Organic Chemistry: Basic Principles and Techniques
chapters.description: Bonding, nomenclature, isomerism, and reaction mechanisms in organic chemistry.

chapters.label: Hydrocarbons
chapters.description: Alkanes, alkenes, alkynes and aromatic hydrocarbons: preparation, properties and reactions.

chapters.label: Environmental Chemistry
chapters.description: Atmospheric, water and soil pollution and green chemistry.

chapters.label: The Solid State
chapters.description: Crystalline solids, unit cells, packing, and defects.

chapters.label: Solutions
chapters.description: Concentration, colligative properties, and Raoult's law.

chapters.label: Electrochemistry
chapters.description: Redox in cells, electrode potentials, the Nernst equation, and conductance.

chapters.label: Chemical Kinetics
chapters.description: Rates of reaction, rate laws, order, and the Arrhenius equation.

chapters.label: Surface Chemistry
chapters.description: Adsorption, catalysis, colloids, and emulsions.

chapters.label: General Principles of Isolation of Elements
chapters.description: Occurrence of metals and the principles of their extraction and refining.

chapters.label: The p-Block Elements (Groups 15–18)
chapters.description: Nitrogen, oxygen, halogen and noble-gas families.

chapters.label: The d- and f-Block Elements
chapters.description: Transition and inner-transition elements: trends and important compounds.

chapters.label: Coordination Compounds
chapters.description: Ligands, nomenclature, isomerism, and bonding theories of complexes.

chapters.label: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
chapters.description: Halogen-containing hydrocarbons: preparation, reactions, and mechanisms.

chapters.label: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
chapters.description: Preparation, properties and reactions of the oxygen-containing families.

chapters.label: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
chapters.description: The carbonyl and carboxyl families: preparation, properties and reactions.

chapters.label: Amines
chapters.description: Nitrogen-containing organic compounds: basicity, preparation and reactions.

chapters.label: Biomolecules
chapters.description: Carbohydrates, proteins, nucleic acids, vitamins and hormones.

chapters.label: Polymers
chapters.description: Classification, methods of polymerisation, and important polymers.

chapters.label: Chemistry in Everyday Life
chapters.description: Drugs, food chemistry, and cleansing agents.
